text:
maya: Quick sync on MerchantX voice asset. Goal: a 20s quote + 10-12m interview clip to feed the May 12 launch and webinar promo. Who's available next week for recording?

sam: Morning works. I'll join to ask product questions.

kevin: For lead routing, route webinar signups from the landing page to SFDC campaign 'Merchant Webinar May' -> SDR queue 'Mid-Market Merchants'. Maya, can you add UTM params?

lina: Legal needs a signed release before publish and quote approval for social. Post the proposed quote here so I can redline.

maya: Draft quote: "Redwood cut our inference costs by nearly 3x, letting us ship faster and scale predictably."

lina: We avoid hard numbers unless Research backs them. @noah can you confirm the benchmark? If Research uploads methodology, legal will allow '~3x' with a parenthetical link.

noah: I ran the Merchant workload tests last month. Median cost improvement ~2.8x. OK to say "~3x" if we attach the CSV + short methodology. I'll upload the file and paste the link by EOD.

publish-bot: Intake ticket created: asset-9213. Checklist: book recording, signed release, quote approval, attach benchmark link, set UTM and SFDC mapping.

kevin: Also recommend CTA split: paid traffic -> demo request, organic -> webinar signup. Ops should map hidden form fields for campaign and UTM. I'll post the flow to #eng-ops.

maya: Proposed slot: Wed 5/5 10:30am PT. 20-minute block. Lock invites?

sam: Confirmed.

kevin: Confirmed. SDR will standby for handoff.

lina: I'll review the release if quote + benchmark link are in by EOD Mon.

maya: I'll lock the calendar, attach pre-interview script, the release draft, and the UTM spec. Thanks! :tada:
